 iStock Delhi Lok Adalat token registration: Know how to download slip, eligible challans and October 25 hearing date.
 Delhi motorists with pending traffic challans can start downloading their Lok Adalat slips from today, October 19, as the process opens on the Delhi Traffic Police website. The online token facility is intended for eligible challans and notices that motorists want to take up for settlement at the upcoming National Lok Adalat.
 Lok Adalat, originally scheduled for October 10, has been postponed to Sunday, October 25, 2026. Delhi Traffic Police has set a daily download limit of 50,000 challans or notices, subject to an overall capacity of 2 lakh. Motorists should therefore check the official portal early rather than assume they can download a slip at any time.
 Lok Adalat Token Registration: When does Delhi Lok Adalat token booking open?
Token downloads are scheduled to begin on October 19, 2026. Delhi Traffic Police advisory says downloads will remain available through October 24, subject to the prescribed limits. 
The official portal is the place to check the available challan or notice and obtain the relevant slip. Motorists should not confuse downloading a slip with confirmation that every pending challan on their vehicle is eligible for settlement.

 How to download a Delhi Lok Adalat token
Motorists can follow these steps to check their challans and access the token facility:
 Visit the official Delhi Traffic Police Lok Adalat portal .
 Enter the vehicle registration number in the field provided.
 Complete the verification code displayed on the page.
 Check the challan or notice details shown by the portal.
 Follow the on-screen instructions to download the available slip and save a copy for the hearing.
 The portal's availability and the number of slips that can be downloaded are subject to the official limits. If the website is busy or the download capacity has been exhausted, motorists should check the official portal for further instructions.
 Delhi Lok Adalat October 2026: Which traffic challans are eligible?
Not every traffic challan can automatically be taken up at a Lok Adalat. The facility is meant for eligible cases, including compoundable traffic violations covered by the relevant arrangements.
The Delhi Traffic Police's online portal currently displays an eligibility notice stating that challans and notices issued up to March 31, 2026, will be allowed for downloading. Motorists should check their individual records on the portal and follow the latest instructions rather than assume that every pending challan qualifies.
 What is a Lok Adalat, and how can it help?
A Lok Adalat is an alternative dispute resolution forum that helps parties settle eligible disputes without going through the full process of regular litigation. Delhi State Legal Services Authority says Lok Adalats handle pending court cases and certain disputes that have not yet reached court, including eligible civil cases and compoundable criminal matters.
For traffic challans, the process provides an opportunity to resolve eligible cases through the designated hearing. However, a token does not guarantee that a challan will be waived or that a particular settlement amount will be offered. The outcome depends on the case and the applicable rules.
 Delhi Lok Adalat Hearing Date: What should motorists do before October 25?
Motorists should check the vehicle's challan details, download the required slip if available and keep the relevant documents ready for the hearing. They should also verify the venue, reporting time and any additional instructions mentioned on their slip or in the official notice.
Since the download facility has a daily limit, people with eligible challans should avoid waiting until the final day. Those who cannot obtain a slip should consult the Delhi Traffic Police's official portal for updates rather than rely on unverified social media messages.
The important dates to remember are October 19 for the start of token downloads and October 25 for the rescheduled National Lok Adalat.
